hero.text: Explore complete books and ebooks published by RCF Publications for students, teachers and English learners.

blocks.title: Books, not resource packs
text: This section lists **complete published titles**: books, ebooks, published study guides and teacher manuals published as books.
Downloadable collections of worksheets, lesson plans and model papers are a different thing, and they live in [Premium Resources](premium-resources/).

blocks.heading: School English support books
text: Grade-by-grade companions for pupils who have fallen behind and need to rebuild English without falling further behind.

blocks.heading: Grammar and examination support
text: Grammar practice and quick reference for the Ordinary Level.

blocks.heading: Spoken English
text: Ready-to-run spoken English lessons for the primary classroom.

blocks.heading: Literature study guides
text: Full study guides to prescribed texts, with examination guidance and model answers.

blocks.heading: Professional and workplace English
text: English for particular kinds of work, for adults already in a job or preparing for one.

blocks.heading: Teacher-development books
text: Books written for teachers rather than pupils.

blocks.heading: Kindle and paperback publications
text: The titles below also appear above under their own subject. They are listed again here because they are sold through Amazon rather than by us: they carry no local price, and a View on Amazon button will appear on each as soon as its product link is supplied.

blocks.heading: How to pay for a book
intro: Open the panel below when you are ready to buy a title. Include the book's product code so we know which one you have paid for.
